  • Iran’s Tasnim says Strait of Hormuz will remain closed to reopening until a Lebanon ceasefire holds. Oil waivers issued to some states.
  • Closure remains selective: Iran allows passage for friendly states while blocking others (ongoing). Tactical: maritime chokepoint still a lever for Iran.
  • Strikes & Military Movements
  • Recent flight scans show military air activity: IAF287, C‑130, RCH313 observed. (Increased airborne logistics / patrols.)
  • No verified new missile strikes or sirens reported in this 2‑hour window.
  • Northern Border / Lebanon
  • Hezbollah activity remains daily along the border. Northern communities report continued fear and disruption.
  • Tasnim links Hormuz reopening to a Lebanon ceasefire — Iran tying maritime pressure to northern front outcomes.
  • Domestic Israeli Developments
  • Educator detained for wearing dual Israeli‑Palestinian flag kippa. Political friction continues over security and education.
  • Public criticism of government policy persists; some ministers blamed for international isolation.
  • 🟢 Good News
  • Second pause on energy strikes is in effect. Direct US‑Iran talks have begun in Switzerland.
  • Threat assessment: Escalating

    • Flight-tracks show continued military air presence (C-130, IAF287, RCH313). Ongoing US/Israeli strike capability remains in theater.
    • Regional groups continue missile/rocket counterstrikes against Israel (ongoing campaign reported).
  • Northern border (Hezbollah)
    • Daily activity on Lebanon front. Reports say Israel-Hezbollah emergency session was discussed in talks. Northern communities remain on alert.
  • Hormuz & shipping
    • Tasnim/Reuters: Hormuz passage remains restricted — Iran says it will not reopen until a Lebanon ceasefire holds. Oil waivers issued to some nations.
    • TASS reports first container ship arrived at an Iranian port after US eased blockade measures.
  • Domestic & other
    • Media items: internal political friction, cultural deaths, and arrests reported; no operational impact confirmed.
  • 🟢 Good News
    • Talks have started in Switzerland. A temporary US pause is in place and a commercial ship reached Iran — small de-escalatory signals.
  • Bottom line: Escalating

Situation Report — Day 27

Ongoing airstrikes on Iran by US/Israel; Iranian/Hezbollah/Hamas missile strikes against Israel reported today.

  • Northern Border — Hezbollah fires at Israel daily. Cross-border strikes and IDF responses continue. Civilian areas in northern towns remain under threat.
  • Hormuz & Shipping — Iran allows passage for select states (Russia, India, China); blocks others. Tasnim: Hormuz not reopening fully until a Lebanon ceasefire holds. First container ship arrived at an Iranian port after the US eased its blockade.
  • Diplomacy & Talks — US and Iranian delegations in Switzerland/Burgenstock today. TASS: discussions focus on Lebanon and frozen assets. Pakistan is mediating talks. Trump announced a second 10-day pause on Iran-targeted energy strikes (deadline Apr 6, 2026, 20:00 ET), citing an Iranian request; Iran publicly denies direct talks.
  • Tactical context — This is the second US pause; first pause was violated hours later by strikes on Isfahan and Khorramshahr. Daily Hezbollah activity increases risk of broader Lebanon front opening.
  • Domestic/Other — Limited civilian casualties and infrastructure damage reported in Lebanon and Iran from recent strikes. Media reports and polls show rising Israeli concern over perceived outcomes.
  • 🟢 Good News — Second pause announced; container ship access restored; US-Iran delegations meeting in Switzerland (potential channel for de‑confliction).
Threat assessment: Escalating

Situation Report — Day 27

No active sirens reported. Hostilities continue.
  • Pause / Diplomacy — Trump announced a SECOND pause on Iran energy strikes: 10 days, deadline Apr 6, 2026 8 PM ET. He cited an "Iranian Government request". Iran denies direct talks. Pakistan is mediating. US‑Iran delegations meeting in Switzerland/Burgenstock (Lebanon / Lebanon ceasefire high on agenda).
  • Airstrikes / Retaliation — US/Israeli airstrikes continue inside Iran (past strikes hit Isfahan, Khorramshahr). Iran, Hezbollah and Hamas continue missile/rocket counterstrikes on Israel. First short pause (Mar 23, 5 days) was violated hours later by strikes — precedent undermines trust in pauses.
  • Northern Border (Hezbollah) — Daily activity. Repeated rocket/missile strikes toward northern Israel. IDF conducts targeted retaliatory strikes across the border.
  • Hormuz & Maritime — Iran selectively reopened Strait of Hormuz to friendly states (Russia, India, China); blocks others. Tasnim: Hormuz won't fully reopen until a Lebanon ceasefire holds. First container ship arrived at Iranian port after US eased blockade.
  • Movements & ISR — Increased military flights reported (C‑130, IAF aircraft). Naval and air patrols intensified in Persian Gulf and eastern Mediterranean.
  • Political — Talks framed around Lebanon and frozen assets. Oil waivers issued to select countries. Credibility of pauses weak after earlier violations.
  • 🟢 Good News — Negotiations underway; second pause aims to reduce energy strikes; first commercial ship through to Iranian port; Pakistan mediating.
Threat assessment: Escalating
